summary: 37 units reviewed. Counts as printed, translations faithful; no invented identifications. 2 errors (jaṅghā rendered as calf in Hindi, against GLOSSARY, u82 and u84), the rest minor wording/notes. Human decisions: u77 gaurava (heaviness vs dignity), u99 ṣaṭkau conjecture, u108 nāsāddṛṣṭy, u94 dvādaśaka, u98 armpit measure, u81 pāṣṇyaḥ form. No regrouping; u82 may continue u81 (not claimed). prabāhu/prapāṇi/trika/dṛṣṭi/aṃsa hedged appropriately.
